newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait, France to hold joint military exercise.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait, France to hold joint military exercise.

text.p: Kuwaiti and French troops will launch week-long joint military exercises in the Gulf Arab state on Saturday, France's embassy in Kuwait said in a statement on Tuesday.
One thousand French troops, four French navy ships, five planes, eight helicopters and 100 vehicles will take part in the exercises code-named "Pearl of the West".
"It aims to increase both countries' common operational capacity...(and) puts into effect its (France's) will to develop efficient military cooperation," the statement added.
The statement did not say how many Kuwaiti troops would take part in the drill which falls under a defence cooperation agreement signed in 1992.
France was a key player in the 1991 U.S.-led military coalition that ended Iraq's seven-month occupation of Kuwait.
Since its liberation, Kuwait has signed similar defence cooperation pacts with the United States, Britain, Russia and China.
